content: The use of e-cigarettes and vaping has gained popularity due to the widespread belief that they are less harmful than traditional combustible cigarettes. However, research has identified significant health risks associated with these products, particularly concerning the cardiovascular and respiratory systems. Individuals with diabetes are strongly advised to refrain from using both combustible cigarettes and electronic cigarettes, as these products may exacerbate health complications associated with their condition. For those who choose to use e-cigarettes as a means to quit smoking, it is critical to avoid the simultaneous use of both combustible and electronic smoking products, a practice known as dual use. Instead, individuals should develop a clear and structured plan aimed at achieving complete cessation of all smoking products to minimize health risks effectively.
